paite: Huai khit in Galili gam ah Jesu avak a; Judate'n amah hihlup atup ziak un Judia gam apha nuam kei hi.
heading: Jesu Leh A-unaute
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

paite: Judate Biakbuk Ankuangluina anaita hi.
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

paite: Huchi in a-unaute'n akiang ah, "Hiai a kipan in Judia gam ah va hoh in, na nungzuite'n na thilhih amuhtheihna ding un," achi uhi.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

paite: "Kuamah in aguk in thil bangmah ahih kei ua, amah mah in alangtang in mite theih ding in ahih hi. Hiai thilte na hih ngalleh khovel kiang ah kimusak in," achi uhi.
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

paite: A-unaute nangawn in leng amah agingta kei uhi.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hun atung nai kei; nou hun zaw chik lai peuh in atung gige hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

paite: Khovel in nou ahon ho thei kei, kei zaw hon ho nak uh, athilhihte uh gilou ahi chih ka theihsak ziak in.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

paite: Nou ankuangluina ah va hohtou unla, kei zaw tu ankuangluina ah ka hohtou tadih kei ding, ka hun atun nai louh ziak in," achi hi.
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

paite: Huai thu akiang uah gen in Galili gam ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

paite: Himahleh a-unaute ankuangluina a ahohtouh nung un, amah leng vantang theih louh in, aguk bang in ahohtou sam hi.
heading: Ankuangluina A Jesu Thuhilh
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

paite: Judate'n ankuangluina ah amah azong ua, "Koi a om ahia?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

paite: Atung ah mipite lak a mi aphun sim supsup ua, khenkhat in, "Mihoih ahi," achi ua; khenkhat in, "Hi dek kei e, mipi khem ahi," achi uhi.
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

paite: Himahleh Judate akihtak ziak un kuamah in alangtang in atungtang thu agenlang ngam kei uhi.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

paite: Ankuanglui san laitak in, tempul ah Jesu ahohtou a, thu ahilh hi.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

paite: Huan Judate'n, "Hiai mi'n zil ngeiloupi a bang achia hichi theih ahia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Ka thuhilh kei a hilou in, hon sawlpa thu ahi zaw.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

paite: Kuapeuh ama deihlam hih ut in ka thuhilh Pathian a kipan hia, keimah phuahtawm a ka gen chih athei ding hi.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

paite: Kuapeuh ama phuahtawm thu gen zaw, ama hoihna zong ahi; asawlpa hoihna zongmi mitak ahi, amah ah diklouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

paite: Mosi in na kiang uah dan ahon pe kei a hia? Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in dan na zui kei uh. Nou bang achia hon hihlup tum na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

paite: Mipi'n, "Dawi zawl na hi ve; kua'n ahia hon hihlup tum?" chi in adawng uhi.
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Thil khat ka hih nou tengteng in lamdang na sa uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

paite: Ahi a, Mosi in zeksum thu nou ahon piak ziak in Sabbath ni in leng mi zek na sum zel uhi. Huai pen Mosi a kipan hilou in pipute a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

paite: Mosi Dan a tatleklouhna ding a Sabbath ni a pasal in azek asum ngalleh, ke'n Sabbath ni a mi ka hihdam ziak in ka tung ah na heh tuam uh maw?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

paite: Akilatdan in ngaihtuah kei unla, diktattak in ngaihtuah zaw un," achi hi.
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a mi khenkhat in, "Hiai mi thah atuppa uh hilou hia?
heading: Khrist, Messia Hihna
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

paite: En dih uh, alangtang in hiai ah thu agen a, akiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi. Amah Khrist ahi chih vaihawmte'n thei taktak uh ahita diam?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

paite: Hiai mi ahong kipatna lam nangawn i thei ngal a. Khrist ahong kilat chiang in ahong kipatna lam kuamah in athei kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

paite: Huaiziak in tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh kawm in akikou a, "Nou na hon thei ua, ka hong kipatna lam leng na thei uh. Himahleh keimah thu a hong pai ka hi kei, amah kei hon sawlpa midik ahi, amah lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

paite: Ke'n amah ka thei; amah a kipan a hong pawt ka hi a, ama'n lah ahon sawl ngal a," achi hi.
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

paite: Huchi in amah mat atumta ua, himahleh ahun atun nai louh ziak in kuamah in akhoih thei kei uhi.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

paite: Mipi akhen tampite'n bel amah agingta ua, "Khrist ahong kilak chiang in, hiai mi hih sang in chiamtehna tamzaw ahih tuan dia hia?" achi uhi.
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

paite: Huan Pharisaite'n atung a mipi phunna thute aza ua; huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah man ding in heutute asawlta uhi.
heading: Jesu Man Ding A Sawlna
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

paite: Jesu'n, "Sawt lou kal na kiang uah ka om phot ding a, hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

paite: Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh; ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

paite: Huan Judate akihou ua, "I muh louh ding in hiai mi koi a hoh dek ahi ding? Grik pemdalhte kiang a hoh in Grikte thu va hilh ding adiam aw?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

paite: Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh, ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh achih, bang achihna adiam maw?" achi uhi.
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

paite: Huan ankuanglui ni nanungpen, ni thupi ni in, Jesu adingh a, akikou a, "Kuapeuh adangtakleh ka kiang ah hong henla, dawn hen.
heading: Tuihing Lui Jesu Ahi
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon gingta Laisiangthou gen bang in tuihing luite asung a pan ahong luangkhe ding," achi hi.
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

paite: Hiai thu agingtate'n Kha atan ding thu uh agenna ahi; Jesu pahtawi a a-om nai louh ziak in Kha lah piak ahi nai tadih ngal kei ua.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

paite: Huchi in mipi lak a khenkhat in huai thu azak un, "Hiai zaw zawlnei hi petmah e," achi uhi.
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

paite: Khenkhat in, hiai zaw, "Khrist ahi," achi ua, khenkhat in bel, "Bang ding in Galili gam ah Khrist ahong pawt tel dia?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

paite: Khrist zaw David suante lak ah, David omna khua Bethlehem a apawt ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou in agen kei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

paite: Huchi in amah ziak in mipi akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

paite: Khenkhat in mat a-ut ua, himahleh kuamah in akhoih tuan kei uh.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

paite: Huan heutute, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang ah ahong pai nawn ua akiang uah, "Bang achia hon tonpih lou?" achi uhi.
heading: Juda Makaite Ginlouhna
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

paite: Heutute'n, "Hiai mi bang in kuamah in thu agen ngei kei," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

paite: Pharisaite'n akiang uah, "Nou leng pimang a om sam na hita uh maw?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

paite: Vaihawmte leh Pharisaite lak a mi amah gingta a-omta a hia?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

paite: Huai dan thei lou mipite sop lai, hamsethuak ei ve ua,” achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

paite: Nikodem, tuma a Jesu kiang a hong, alak ua pang sam ahi a, ama'n akiang uah,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

paite: "Amah kam ngei a thu zak leh athilhih theih ahih ma, i dan un mi siam louh atangsak ngei a hia?" achi hi.
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nang leng huai Galili mi na hi sam maw? Zong lechin, Galili gam ah zawlnei kuamah pawt ding a-om kei uh chih thei tanla," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

paite: Huan michih ama inn chiat ah apaita uhi.
english: Everyone went to his own house,
